title: Gradient fill model lacks full matrix — FLA import loses gradient scale/position/center
description: toFill() in flash8-import.ts converts the gradient's FLA matrix to just an angle (Math.atan2(f.matrix.b, f.matrix.a)), discarding scale, translation, and aspect ratio. LinearGradientFill and RadialGradientFill model types only hold angle — there is no matrix field. When re-encoded to SWF via encodeDefineShape4, the gradient is auto-fit to the shape's bounding box. Gradients that were manually offset, scaled to a fraction of the shape, or skewed in the original FLA will render differently after import+publish. For radial gradients, the center position (tx/ty) is also lost — a radial gradient centered off the bounding box center appears centered on the box. Fix: (a) add matrix?: { a,b,c,d,tx,ty } to LinearGradientFill/RadialGradientFill in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts; (b) populate from FLA import in flash8-import.ts; (c) use in SWF encoder gradient matrix calculation in shapes.ts instead of auto-fitting to bounding box.
